courses.title: System design

units.description: Apply the building blocks to end-to-end design problems.

courses.title: Coding
courses.subtitle: Build the components yourself
courses.description: Write, run, and debug JavaScript building blocks for real services. Every exercise has executable tests.

units.description: Deduplicate, count, group, and batch data safely.

units.title: Put a service together
units.description: Build one gateway from several functions that share state, admitting work against a budget and a capacity limit.
